data.one_liner: A custom implementation of a slider drawer menu with animations and customizable app bars.
data.what_it_does: Provides a slider drawer menu component supporting custom animation times, multiple opening directions (Left-to-Right, Right-to-Left, Top-to-Bottom), shadow effects, and built-in or custom app bars. It allows developers to control the drawer state programmatically via a GlobalKey.
use_when: You need a drawer menu that slides over or pushes the main screen with a custom sliding animation.
You want directional slider opening like Left-to-Right, Right-to-Left, or Top-to-Bottom.
avoid_when: You strictly need the standard Material Design endDrawer or Scoped Drawer behavior without custom sliding layout wrappers.
strengths: Supports multiple slide directions (RTL, LTR, TTB)
Customizable shadow, animation duration, and app bar integration
weaknesses: Limited to specific slider drawer layout paradigms
Requires wrapping standard scaffold contents inside the SliderDrawer widget
